steps.hardClue: Temporarily power both facilities, then open the bunker.
steps.clue: Temporarily power both laboratories and open the bunker.

steps.hardClue: Complete the four skull rituals to obtain the ancient weapon.
steps.clue: Complete the four skull rituals to obtain the Skull of Nan Sapwe.

steps.hardClue: Use the ancient weapon to restore the hidden elevator plans.
steps.clue: Use the Skull of Nan Sapwe to restore the hidden elevator plans.

steps.hardClue: Collect three cogs from a hidden room, from beneath a zipline and from a destroyed aircraft.
steps.clue: Collect three cogs using the anti-aircraft gun, electrified zipline and Anywhere But Here!

steps.hardClue: Install the three cogs and activate the elevator.
steps.clue: Install the three cogs and activate the elevator.

steps.hardClue: Descend beneath the bunker and clear the roots with the upgraded Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Descend beneath the bunker and clear the roots with the upgraded KT-4.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the boss by destroying his four exposed spores.
steps.clue: Defeat Mutated Takeo by shooting his four exposed spores with the Masamune.
